name: devkit
description: Multi-agent development pipeline: /dev-spec builds a grounded task spec, /dev-plan triages and turns it into a validated step plan, /dev-implement runs the steps in dependency waves with contract gates and cost-driven review checkpoints, /dev-review loops reviewers until clean, /dev-pr drafts and gates publication. Context is push-only and every file has one writer; verification means running a check, not reading code.
